_comment: Overrides the /routes/ body only. One entry is missing 'id', the other is missing 'color' -- the old code direct-indexed colors[r['id']] = r['color'] and would KeyError on either (IMPORTANT 3). The fixed route_colors() must skip both and return an empty/partial dict instead of crashing; fetch_trips then falls back to the #888888 default bullet color for route 'G'.
